dish: Okinawan 'okazu' plate (five vegetables and island tofu), tebichi simmered two days, hirayāchi, taco rice
n: Taishū Shokudō Mickey, Park Avenue (大衆食堂ミッキー)
w: A decades-old one-woman shokudō on Koza's Park Avenue carrying on her mother's recipes; OTV Okitive profiled its never-shared 'secret' family flavour, and KozaWeb lists it among Koza's taco-rice and A-sign-era diners. The okazu plate of five vegetables and island tofu is the house signature.

dish: Teppanyaki tenderloin steak cooked at the table, with shrimp cocktail (the 1970 three-item menu)
n: Sam's Anchor Inn Ginowan (サムズアンカーイン 宜野湾店)
w: The founding branch of Okinawa's Sam's steak chain, opened on Route 58 in Mashiki in August 1970 by American Ray Payne; its then-novel teppanyaki show and original menu of shrimp cocktail and tenderloin made it a pre-reversion steak institution. The Ryukyu Shimpo marked the chain's 55th anniversary in 2025.
